item.title: Saying AOC Is As Dumb As A Box Of Rocks, Insults The Rocks
item.description: Her voice sounds like a combination of Minnie Mouse and nails on a chalkboard, and her IQ can’t break double digits, yet AOC has somehow convinced the voters in New York's 14th congressional district to vote for her. I have no idea how she ever won the position in the first place, but the fact that this absolute zero has held the position since 2019 is mind-numbing.

item.title: John Fetterman, The Last Moderate Democrat
item.description: Decades ago, the Democratic Party had leaders like Presidents Harry Truman and John F. Kennedy who were proud of our county and our citizens. These leaders would have never embarked on a foreign “apology tour” like President Barack Obama or allowed our country to be invaded by millions of illegal immigrants like President Joe Biden.

item.title: Children of Hamelin: The End of the Story
item.description: And the Piper advanced and the children followed,And when all were in to the very last,The door in the mountain-side shut fast.--The Pied Piper of Hamelin: A Child's Story What determines the future of states and entire civilizations? The most profound, and at the same time simplest, answer was given by Samuel Smiles, a mid-19th-century British philosopher.

item.title: Al Gore Continues to Promote Fear
item.description: Al Gore’s ‘An Inconvenient Truth’ has been conveniently forgotten 20 years after it made a series of very specific predictions that—to no one’s surprise –have yet to come to pass. Within months, the likes of Leonardo DiCaprio and Cameron Diaz were explaining climate science on chat shows, journalists were treating them like experts, and anyone who raised doubts was waved off as selfish or backwards. (1)

item.title: Will Louisiana State Police Continue Dirt Bike and ATV Enforcement After Mardi Gras?
item.description: I've been watching local social media cover this long-overdue victory, namely the Instagram page belonging to 'Empower You Nola', a safety advocacy and firearms training business owned by a former New Orleans Police Department officer. Most comments support wholesale arrest and seizure of ATVs and dirt bikes, which are illegal to operate within city limits. They were allowed to rule our roads under the previous mayor, who catered to them.

item.title: Can grid handle next Winter Storm Fern, solar flare or enemy attack?
item.description: Winter Storm Fern (January 23-27) dumped heavy snow and ice on more than 240,000,000 Americans across 40 states and 2,300 miles, beginning in Arizona and wrapping up in Maine.Scores died, including 20 in New York City, where Mayor Mamdani refused to close homeless camps or compel “unhoused residents” to move indoors, instead letting them rely on the “warmth of collectivism.”

item.title: CCF Writes to Durham Region Questioning New Offensive Speech Reporting Tool
item.description: TORONTO – Today, the Canadian Constitution Foundation’s Litigation Director, Josh Dehaas, wrote to officials of the Region of Durham with concerns about the recently announced Community-Based Hate Reporting Program, which will unconstitutionally limit the free expression of Durham residents.

item.title: Cost of federal bureaucracy up 80 per cent in 10 years: PBO
item.description: OTTAWA, ON: The Canadian Taxpayers Federation is calling on Prime Minister Mark Carney to immediately shrink the federal bureaucracy following today’s Parliamentary Budget Officer report showing costs continue to increase.

item.title: Pressure Jordan--not Israel--to end the Jewish-Arab conflict
item.description: Continuing pressure on Israel to agree to the creation of a Palestinian Arab state between Israel and Jordan (two-State solution) came with a Joint Statement issued on February 9, 2026 by the Foreign Ministers of the United Arab Emirates, the Republic of Türkiye, the Arab Republic of Egypt, the Hashemite Kingdom of Jordan, the Republic of Indonesia, the Islamic Republic of Pakistan, the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, and the State of Qatar.
